description: pglib-uc, published by IEEE PES Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms, provides IEEE PES task-force unit-commitment benchmark cases with demand, reserve requirements and thermal or renewable generator parameters in JSON. Coverage: Cases are curated benchmark scenarios, including California ISO and FERC-derived inputs; individual cases determine their time series and system size. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The collection targets one specified mixed-integer unit-commitment formulation; it is not a complete operational grid dataset. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
